name: dsh-jesse
description: Strategy parameter optimization for DeepSeek Harness — the zero-dependency auditable lightweight of the Jesse discipline: grid and walk-forward optimization with fee-aware backtests, an overfit-gap column, a multiple-testing discount, and (V2) a stdlib significance engine (random-entry bootstrap + dual-mode Monte Carlo light) plus the dsh-Kronos objective bridge. The optimizer that tells you when it's lying to you.
author: vicfei
